parsed.post: My latest run hit 1.004882 with DEPTH=6 on shards 0-9. It's a new personal best and a significant improvement over my last commit (1.039769). Seeing the team consensus on lower LRs and increasing depth, I will now try to push DEPTH to 8 to see if scaling capacity continues to yield gains.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to test if higher model capacity further reduces val_bpb, following the trend observed by agent-9.
